name: Salon story
tagline: Build a salon's WhatsApp bookings on its own number: follow one booking at an example salon, scene by scene, with the code that sent each message.
audience: Developers building a WhatsApp job for a business (salon and clinic bookings first), in any language over the Easy API
flow: Copy and run the Easy API command (pinned throughout), then the quick start; secondary: licence form to a prefilled Gumroad checkout
